snippet.description:
The mysterious object carried by an Ancient Egyptian figure

An ancient Egyptian carving shows a figure holding a strange object that has sparked curiosity for generations. Its unusual shape and detailed design make it difficult to understand what it was originally meant to represent.

Was it a ceremonial object, a religious symbol, or something with a practical purpose? 

Take a closer look at this fascinating ancient carving and decide what you think it could be.
